SetupHeading: Let’s get your CPU temperature working
开始读取 CPU 温度
SetupIntroduction: FantasyMontior uses PawnIO, a hardware-access driver, to read low-level CPU and motherboard sensors. Other readings can work even when this driver is missing.
FantasyMontior 使用 PawnIO 硬件访问驱动读取 CPU 和主板底层传感器。即使未安装此驱动，其他读数也可能正常。
ElevationGuide: FantasyMontior requests administrator access at launch so it can read CPU temperatures through PawnIO. Approve the Windows prompt to continue. If you cancel, the app will not open. There is no need to select Run as administrator yourself.
FantasyMontior 启动时会请求管理员权限，以便通过 PawnIO 读取 CPU 温度。请允许 Windows 提示以继续；取消后应用将退出，无需手动选择“以管理员身份运行”。
AlreadyInstalled: Already installed? Continue to step 2. This app does not download or install anything when you open the guide.
已安装？请继续第 2 步。打开本指南不会下载或安装任何内容。
RestartGuide: After installing PawnIO for the first time, close this app and open it again so the library can detect the driver. Approve the Windows administrator prompt at launch. If the installer requests a Windows restart, do that first. Retry discovery alone does not refresh the startup driver status.
首次安装 PawnIO 后，请关闭并重新打开应用，使硬件库检测到驱动，并允许启动时的管理员权限提示。如果安装程序要求重启 Windows，请先重启。仅重新检测不会更新启动时的驱动状态。
CheckTemperatureGuide: Return to CPU & GPU. Look for a plausible temperature that changes between idle and normal activity. An Installed status only confirms driver presence; a Live value or a constant 0°C does not prove the sensor is working.
返回“CPU 和 GPU”，观察温度是否合理，以及是否随空闲和正常活动变化。“已安装”仅表示存在驱动；“实时”读数或恒定的 0°C 并不能证明传感器正常。
TroubleshootingHeading: Still missing or stuck at zero?
TroubleshootingGuide: Check that the status above shows PawnIO installed and Administrator. Launch FantasyMontior.exe directly from its application folder if you are using an older shortcut or a development tool that does not request elevation.
请确认上方状态显示 PawnIO 已安装且具有管理员权限。如果旧快捷方式或开发工具未请求提权，请从应用目录直接启动 FantasyMontior.exe。
